title: Indexed Walsh basis
statement: For a finite index set $\iota$, the indexed Walsh basis of the real-valued functions on $\{−1,1\}^{\iota}$ consists of the sign monomials indexed by all subsets $S\subseteq\iota$. It is a basis over $\mathbb R$.
